period_note: Sourced from the Annual Report 2023's own 'Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials (consolidated) by the Audit Committee and by the Board' table. *** MISLABELLING FOUND: despite this table's caption saying '(consolidated)' -- the same caption wording used in FY2022/FY2024/FY2025 -- the figures actually populated in THIS SPECIFIC YEAR's table are SOLO, not Consolidated. This is the opposite of what the label says, and the opposite of the FY2022/2024/2025 pattern (see those years' notes, where the '(consolidated)' label is genuinely accurate). *** PROOF: this table's Dec-31-2023 column (Total Property and Assets 414,401.58m, Total Capital & Shareholders' Equity 27,353.85m, Net Profit After Tax 4,345.53m, NAV per share 22.18) reproduces EXACTLY against this dataset's own independently-sourced FY2023 Solo Q4 figures (bank_financials/PREMIERBAN/quarterly/2023_Q4.json, from the audited Solo Balance Sheet/P&L) and DIVERGES from the FY2023 report's own separate, full Consolidated Balance Sheet/Consolidated Profit and Loss Account (Total Assets 414,966.38m, Profit after taxation 4,154.77m -- materially different from this table's 4,345.53m). This is GOOD NEWS for series consistency: FY2023 Q1-Q3 below are on the SAME Solo basis as this dataset's main Q4/annual series, UNLIKE FY2022/2024/2025 which carry a genuine Consolidated-vs-Solo mismatch. Per project instruction to prefer Solo-basis interim data when found and to record any basis-related finding explicitly: this is a mislabelling inside the bank's own report, not a data-sourcing choice made here, and it is recorded here precisely so a future reader does not assume FY2023 shares FY2022/2024/2025's Consolidated-mismatch problem. No independent same-period comparator table exists to cross-check FY2023 Q1-Q3 for restatement (single-current-year-only table, as with FY2022/2024/2025).
